en: You're a Pokémon trainer, aren't you? Sootopolis's Juan has lots of fans. Even more than his pupil Wallace!
text: Ești Antrenor Pokémon, nu-i așa? Juan din Sootopolis are mulți fani. Chiar mai mulți decât elevul lui, Wallace!

en: Oh! Then you must be very strong.
Oh dear, that's a little lonely. Work hard, and the fans will come!
text: Vai, e puțin singuratic. Muncește din greu și vor veni fanii!
